questions.passage: This means that by following their food preferences — eating a variety of tasty foods — people are no longer assured that they will get a __________ (nutrition) adequate diet.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

This means that by following their food preferences — eating a variety of tasty foods — people are no longer assured that they will get a __________ (nutrition) adequate diet.

det.korean: nutrition(명사) → nutritionally(부사): 뒤에 오는 형용사 adequate를 수식하는 자리라 부사 nutritionally가 맞음
det.analysis: 형용사 adequate를 수식 → 부사 nutritionally. -ally 부사 접미사
det.tip: 형용사 수식은 부사. nutritionally adequate(영양학적으로 충분한)

questions.passage: Technology has made it possible to manipulate foods ' sensory properties to make them sweeter or saltier or richer tasting or more colorful at will. Thus, technology has fully separated the tastiness of foods from their nutritional worth. In addition, current technology creates notorious hazards for energy ____________. The fat content of many processed foods is not clearly evident from either the appearance of the food, its feel and taste, or from the packaging and shape of the item. The energy content of a variety of similar-tasting foods can __________. And the array of such processed food products, made tasty by the addition of fat, sugar, and salt, is vast. This means that by following their food preferences — eating a variety of tasty foods — people are no longer assured that they will get a nutritionally adequate diet. exchange efficiency generation perception consumption
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: vary considerably(상당히 다양하다) — 비슷한 맛의 식품들이라도 에너지 함량은 크게 다르다는 원문 핵심 대비
det.analysis:
✅ ① vary considerably: 원문 그대로. 비슷한 맛 ≠ 같은 에너지 함량
❌ ② remain identical: '동일하게 유지'라 원문 대비 구조와 정반대
❌ ③ stay unchanged: '변하지 않음'도 원문 대비와 반대
❌ ④ match exactly: '정확히 일치'로 원문의 차이 강조와 모순
det.tip: similar-tasting foods + energy content: 맛은 비슷해도 에너지는 vary considerably

Thus, technology has fully separated the tastiness of foods from their nutritional worth. In addition, current technology creates notorious hazards for energy ____________. The fat content of many processed foods is not clearly evident from either the appearance of the food, its feel and taste, or from the packaging and shape of the item. The energy content of a variety of similar-tasting foods can vary considerably. And the array of such processed food products, made tasty by the addition of fat, sugar, and salt, is vast. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: no longer assured(더 이상 보장되지 않는) — 맛 위주 식습관 때문에 영양 충분한 식단을 얻는다는 '보장이 사라진' 상태
det.analysis:
❌ ① fully guaranteed: '완전히 보장됨'은 원문 부정 결론과 정반대
✅ ④ no longer assured: 원문 그대로. 부정 결론
❌ ③ always certain: '항상 확실함'도 원문과 반대
❌ ② entirely confident: '완전히 확신'도 긍정 방향으로 반대
det.tip: people are [no longer assured] that they will get a nutritionally adequate diet — 부정 결론
